findings.title: Staged evidence index retains repository-relative links outside the project prefix
findings.measurement: At /qore-codex-skills/evidence/README.md, ../../../profiles/qaizen-labs.json and the three ../../ references on line 20 resolve outside /qore-codex-skills/; all four returned HTTP 404. Raw URLs/statuses are in followup-observations.json.
findings.reader_failure: A reader following this index cannot reach the maintained profile, demonstration explanation, preparation guide or dependency limits through the supplied relative references.
findings.minimal_remedy: Rewrite staged Markdown links to valid in-prefix copied public targets or exact candidate repository URLs, and recursively validate links from staged Markdown.
